outcome: When I rearrange a system diagram so it makes sense to me, let me decide when that arrangement becomes the saved version — without changing the actual system architecture.
successCriterion: Dragging may change the working layout without persistence; Save arrangement persists the current layout; reload restores only the last explicitly saved arrangement; reset requires confirmation and returns to deterministic defaults.

acceptanceScenarios.title: Moving a box does not save automatically
acceptanceScenarios.when: I drag a box and do not choose Save arrangement
acceptanceScenarios.then: reopening the same revision restores the previously saved arrangement rather than the unsaved movement

acceptanceScenarios.title: Explicit save becomes the restored arrangement
acceptanceScenarios.given: I have moved one or more boxes
acceptanceScenarios.when: I choose Save arrangement and then reopen the same exact revision
acceptanceScenarios.then: the explicitly saved arrangement is restored

acceptanceScenarios.title: Reset requires confirmation
acceptanceScenarios.then: the workbench asks for confirmation before deleting the saved arrangement

acceptanceScenarios.title: Cancelling reset keeps the arrangement
acceptanceScenarios.then: the current and saved arrangement remain unchanged

acceptanceScenarios.title: Confirmed reset returns to defaults
acceptanceScenarios.then: the saved arrangement is deleted and deterministic default positions return

acceptanceScenarios.title: Storage failure remains usable
acceptanceScenarios.when: I move boxes or attempt to save
acceptanceScenarios.then: the diagram remains usable and clearly says the arrangement cannot be remembered

implementationImpact.label: Layout persistence contract
reasons: Keep persistence exact-revision-bound, positions-only, and browser-local.

implementationImpact.label: Graph interaction
reasons: Dragging marks the layout unsaved; only Save arrangement persists positions.

implementationImpact.label: Product feedback and copy
reasons: Expose unsaved state, explicit save, visible save receipt, and reset confirmation in task language.

implementationImpact.label: Reset behavior
reasons: Reset positions requires explicit confirmation before clearing local saved state.

implementationImpact.label: Verification
reasons: Cover explicit save, unsaved drag, confirm/cancel reset, stale revision, and storage failure.

implementationImpact.label: Release artifact
reasons: Build and retain the v1.4 candidate and implementation-loop artifacts from the exact tested revision.

verification.statement: Acceptance scenarios in this brief are planned checks. Their presence is not evidence that they ran or passed.
